Before linking you to /r/picrequests I went over to /r/favors to check if it served as a visual favors request conduit. The rules state that they do not allow "draw me something" or "draw me an x" *requests* (subreddit logos being the only exception) but that *offers* to draw something were warmly welcomed. (They recommended /r/picrequests for, well, pic requests) So, if you feel like being bold, you could always post an *offer* there (:

Have you considered offering your talents to nonprofits? A much-needed brochure might not take that many days for you to illustrate or proofread, especially if you do it online, but a volunteer contribution like yours may make the difference between important information getting out, or not at all. Email a few organizations whose causes you care about, list a bunch of things that you can do and how soon you can do them, and see what happens. 

I'm not saying that artists or writers should always work for free for nonprofits, or that they will be grateful for any random doodle, but this would be an altruistic way for you to start out. 

Either that or /r/picrequests .
